subject: Fraud & Scams
title: Pharming: Poisoning the Web
description: Learn Pharming: Poisoning the Web in one minute.

hook.text: You type your bank's correct URL into the browser. You still end up on a fake site.

buildup.text: Pharming redirects traffic from real websites to fake copies by poisoning DNS servers.

discovery.text: Unlike phishing, you don't need to click a bad link. The internet itself routes you to the fraud.

twist.text: In 2017, a pharming attack redirected 6,000 users of a Brazilian bank to a perfect clone for hours.

climax.text: Pharming is rare but devastating because victims do everything right and still lose.

punchline.text: The right URL can lead to the wrong site.

quiz.question: How does pharming differ from phishing?
options: It redirects traffic without needing a victim to click
It only works on mobile phones
